## Quotation scope
Features and specifications vary by model. MOQ, price, sample terms, production lead time, warranty and destination compliance need confirmation for the selected model. The website inquiry form prepares a WhatsApp message for the visitor to review and send. It does not automatically submit to an email inbox or CRM.
